services.name: Interior Painting

services.name: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Protect and beautify your home's exterior with durable weather-resistant coatings. Our Melbourne exterior painting service covers cladding, fascia, window frames, and more.

services.name: House Painting
services.desc: Complete house painting packages covering every surface inside and out. We coordinate the entire project efficiently so you get a cohesive, fresh look throughout your home.

services.name: Surface Preparation
services.desc: Proper preparation is the foundation of a great paint job. We fill cracks, sand surfaces, prime bare timber, and repair minor damage before any paint goes on.

services.name: Wallpaper Removal
services.desc: Safely strip old wallpaper and prepare walls for a smooth, modern painted finish. We handle stubborn adhesives and damaged plaster with expert care.

services.name: Protective Coatings
services.desc: Extend the life of your surfaces with protective sealants and coatings. Ideal for high-traffic areas, wet zones, and timber elements exposed to harsh Melbourne weather.

tagline: Top Quality House Painting For A Fair Price
aboutText: With over 15 years of experience painting homes across Melbourne and surrounding suburbs, Mcintosh Painters has built a solid reputation for delivering top-quality finishes at fair, honest prices. Our team of licensed and fully insured painters takes genuine pride in every brushstroke, from detailed interior work to complete exterior transformations. We use premium paints and proven preparation techniques to ensure your home looks its best for years to come. Whether it is a single room refresh or a full house repaint, we treat every project with the same meticulous care and attention to detail.
servicesText: Mcintosh Painters offers a comprehensive range of painting services tailored to Melbourne homes. From interior feature walls to full exterior repaints, our skilled team delivers flawless results using premium materials and industry-leading techniques.

testimonials.name: Sarah Mitchell
testimonials.text: Dave and his team did a fantastic job painting our entire two-storey home in Melbourne. The prep work was thorough and the finish is absolutely flawless. Highly recommend Mcintosh Painters to anyone looking for reliable, top-quality house painting.

testimonials.name: James Thornton
testimonials.text: We hired Mcintosh Painters for interior painting of our renovated home and could not be happier. They were punctual, professional, and the attention to detail on our trim and cornices was exceptional. Fair pricing and a brilliant result.

testimonials.name: Karen Walsh
testimonials.text: After years of dealing with peeling paint on our weatherboard house, Mcintosh Painters gave it a complete exterior makeover. The house looks brand new and the protective coating should keep it looking great for a long time. Outstanding service.
